agent_interaction: Starts from Agent 2 session 079 on main; its merged maintenance commit is the live remote head used for the verification task.

candidates.observed_friction: The previous real publication verification fetched a complete commit diff only to obtain the remote main SHA; the response was 50,475 tokens and truncated.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: The authenticated commit endpoint is the appropriate verification baseline even when a public Git remote is already available.
candidates.simpler_alternative: Use one native git fetch followed by rev-parse of the remote commit and tree.
candidates.problem_evidence: Session 078 connector fetch of main returned the required SHA with an oversized truncated diff.
candidates.potential_value: A bounded remote-head receipt without irrelevant patch content or another wrapper.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: Measure serialized response bytes and identity agreement on the current remote main.
candidates.cost: Two observed one-call conditions plus reporting.

candidates.observed_friction: The current full fresh clone and branch listing took 21.5 seconds.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: A full clone is required before every read-only branch audit.
candidates.simpler_alternative: A shallow or filtered clone followed by explicit branch fetches.
candidates.problem_evidence: Current startup timing, but branch ancestry and git cherry quality requirements make the substitute non-equivalent.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: Clone shallowly and verify all merged/no-merged and patch-equivalence classifications.
candidates.cost: Another network clone and a more complex quality check; not selected.

candidates.observed_friction: Agent 2 advanced main between Agent 1 sessions, while continuity files remain single-writer artifacts.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: Fresh main plus fast-forward publication is sufficient to avoid every two-agent conflict.
candidates.simpler_alternative: Keep current fresh-clone and expected-SHA lease checks.
candidates.problem_evidence: No actual conflict occurred; the current clone already included Agent 2 session 079.
candidates.potential_value: Prevent lost ledger or checkpoint updates.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: Observe the first real conflicting write rather than manufacture one.
candidates.cost: No valid test today; rejected for lack of activation.

selected_plan.real_task: Verify the current public remote main commit and exact tree before using it as the session baseline.
selected_plan.observed_problem: The previous connector verification returned the right commit SHA together with a large irrelevant diff that was truncated.
selected_plan.baseline: One github_fetch_commit call for ref main; measure the complete serialized tool result without printing its diff.
selected_plan.hypothesis: One native git fetch plus rev-parse returns the same commit and tree with at least 90% fewer serialized UTF-8 response bytes and no truncation.
selected_plan.quality_control: Both conditions must identify the same remote commit; obtain the exact tree and match it to origin/main^{tree}; preserve call counts and do not infer token or LLM gains.
selected_plan.overhead: Count one connector call, one shell call, local serialization measurement and reporting.
selected_plan.stop_condition: Stop without code if identities disagree, the native command needs more than one outer call, or the existing Git remote is unavailable. Do not build a wrapper.

measurement_failure: The first orchestration completed an extra connector baseline call but failed before the intervention because TextEncoder was unavailable. The retry used a local UTF-8 byte counter. This failed setup call is retained as overhead and the trace does not claim latency or token savings.
decision_reason: For a public repository with an existing clone, native git fetch plus rev-parse returned the exact commit and tree in one outer call with 99.9533% fewer serialized response bytes. Keep this as a workflow practice; use the connector only when public Git cannot supply the required receipt, and do not build a wrapper.
limitations: One LAB publication workflow with an existing public clone. Serialized tool-response bytes are not network bytes or model tokens. The connector baseline exposed a full diff but not the tree; the native condition exposed only the two required identities. This does not establish general agent or LLM benefit.
